title: Assemble Development Engine V1 certification candidate
objective: Compose a bounded Development Engine V1 certification candidate from existing exact repository evidence, validate SAFE FAST zero-cost and security prerequisites fail-closed, and prepare the stable candidate for a later exact-head T4 certification without unlocking business development.
non_goals: certify the candidate in the same work unit
modify Lot45 candidate or business code
adopt or execute the Lot45 mutation profile
resolve or suppress BOOT-FINDING-001 by assertion
modify branch protection or repository rulesets
introduce paid services or mandatory LLM review

outputs.name: Development Engine V1 certification adversarial tests

forbidden_semantics: Development Engine V1 final certification verdict

required_invariants: WU13 evidence remains PASS and its temporary qualification workflow is removed with permanent controls green
security engine evidence remains PASS_ENGINEERING_SECURITY and its external-protection blocker is preserved
mandatory-cost evidence remains scoped to zero mandatory paid requirements and never claims account-wide zero billing
cold-start and interruption-recovery evidence remain PASS without conversational context dependence
critical R3 bypass evidence remains PASS and preserves exact-head plus deep-assurance floors
Lot45 pilot evidence remains read-only and the business candidate remains suspended
SAFE and FAST are derived from explicit evidence and policy fields rather than prose
BOOT-FINDING-001 blocks future business unlock but does not get silently converted into an engine-security PASS
candidate identity binds exact evidence blob SHAs and certification-policy content through deterministic SHA-256 material
candidate assembly cannot mark itself CERTIFIED and cannot unlock business or runtime execution
acceptance_criteria: certification policy enumerates required SAFE FAST zero-cost security and pilot evidence
candidate validates all required evidence schema identities verdicts and safety locks
FAST requires routine timing budgets T0<=250ms T1<=500ms T2<=750ms total<=1500ms plus cold-start and recovery under 1000ms
SAFE requires security engine PASS mandatory-cost PASS R3 bypass PASS and unchanged business safety locks
candidate records BOOT-FINDING-001 as an external business-unlock blocker
changing an evidence blob identity expected verdict safety lock or timing threshold fails closed
no workflow business source historical evidence or active mutation control is modified

done_when: Development Engine V1 certification candidate is deterministic and validates SAFE FAST zero-cost security and pilot prerequisites
candidate identity is bound to exact repository evidence and remains uncertified until a later exact-head T4 work unit
BOOT-FINDING-001 remains visible as a business-unlock blocker
business development remains paused and Lot46 remains locked
